question: What characterizes a person who becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: The person is driven by greed.
The person is fickle and unstable.
Such a person is called a mockery of the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The agreement of capalā with the subject is contextually interpretive.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
